headline: Nvidia Earnings Beat Expectations but Stock Falls 5%
body: Nvidia reported fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter earnings of $1.62 per share (+82.0% YoY) on revenue of $68.1 billion (+73.2% YoY), with Morgan Stanley calling it "the largest and cleanest beat in semis industry history." Despite the blockbuster results and guidance of $78.0 billion for Q1 2027, shares fell 5% as investors reacted to concerns about the sustainability of the AI trade and potential market saturation. Retail investors showed strong buying interest, recording their highest net purchases since 2012, but institutional selling pressure dominated the post-earnings reaction.

headline: Trade Desk Plummets 16% After Weak Q1 Guidance
body: The Trade Desk (TTD) saw its stock price crater by more than 16% in pre-market trading following the company's fourth-quarter 2025 earnings report. While the digital advertising platform beat revenue expectations, investors reacted negatively to weaker-than-expected fiscal 2026 first-quarter guidance and margin pressure concerns. The sharp decline reflects growing doubts about the independent platform model as ad-tech growth shows signs of slowing, despite record revenue performance in the previous quarter.

headline: NCR Atleos Surges 15% on $6.6B Brinks Acquisition
body: NCR Atleos shares jumped 15% in premarket trading after Brinks Co announced a cash-and-stock deal valued at $6.6 billion including debt. The acquisition values each NCR Atleos share at $50.40, representing a 24% premium over the closing price on February 25th. The deal creates a leading financial technology infrastructure company, combining Brinks' cash management and logistics expertise with NCR Atleos' ATM and banking technology solutions.

headline: Marriott Vacations Jumps 8% on Strong Q4 Earnings
body: Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation shares rose 8% before the bell after reporting fourth-quarter earnings that exceeded analyst expectations. The vacation ownership company delivered better-than-expected quarterly results and provided an upbeat financial forecast for 2026, driving strong investor confidence in the travel and leisure sector. The earnings beat reflects continued strength in vacation ownership demand and pricing power.

headline: Qnity Soars on AI-Driven Semiconductor Demand
body: Qnity Electronics forecast full-year 2026 earnings above analysts' estimates, benefiting from strong demand for artificial intelligence in the semiconductor sector. The newly listed semiconductor solutions provider saw shares jump more than 3.5% after an earnings and revenue beat, along with better-than-expected earnings guidance for full-year 2026. The company's critical position in the AI supply chain has analysts raising price targets to $140 per share from $110.
